definition_zh: 独裁者；专制君主；独断专行的人
definition_en: a ruler with absolute power; also, any person who insists on complete control over others
core_image: 一个人攥着所有权力，别人只能照办
scene: 会议室里没人敢抬头，一切等他拍板。The editor-in-chief ran the paper like an autocrat.
sceneCN: 这里 autocrat 指「独断专行的人」（第 2 个义项：非政治场合的独裁式人物）；句意：这位总编像个独裁者一样经营报社。

pos.zh: 独裁者；专制君主；独断专行者

collocations.zh: 克里姆林宫的独裁者（旧指沙皇）

derivatives.zh: 女独裁者（罕用，拉丁化女性形式）

senses.title: A ruler with absolute power
senses.definition: a ruler, such as a tsar or emperor, holding unlimited political power
senses.definitionCN: 握有无限政治权力的统治者，如沙皇、皇帝
senses.example: The Russian tsar styled himself an autocrat of all the Russias.
senses.exampleCN: 俄国沙皇自称「全俄罗斯的专制君主」。
senses.why: The Greek parts mean self and power: one person is the whole government.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语成分意为「自身」与「权力」：一人即整个政府。

senses.title: A domineering person
senses.definition: anyone who insists on deciding everything and tolerates no dissent
senses.definitionCN: 坚持独断一切、不容异议的人
senses.example: Grandfather was a benevolent autocrat at the dinner table.
senses.exampleCN: 祖父在餐桌上是个仁慈的独裁者。
senses.why: The political type was so vivid that homes and kitchens inherited the word.
senses.whyCN: 政治形象过于鲜明，家庭与厨房便继承了这个词。

senses.title: Of regimes and systems
senses.definition: a ruler who embodies autocracy as a system of government
senses.definitionCN: 体现独裁政体的统治者
senses.example: Nineteenth-century Europe was a family of autocrats.
senses.exampleCN: 十九世纪的欧洲是一个独裁君主家族。
senses.why: Where autocracy is the constitution, its occupant is the autocrat.
senses.whyCN: 专制既是国体，其占据者便是 autocrat。

senses.title: The benevolent autocrat
senses.definition: an absolute ruler or boss who claims to dictate for the good of all
senses.definitionCN: 自称一切独断皆为众人福祉的绝对统治者或上司
senses.example: He ran the school as a benevolent autocrat and modernized it completely.
senses.exampleCN: 他以开明专制者的方式治校，将其彻底现代化。
senses.why: Power without consent excuses itself as wisdom; the phrase records the excuse.
senses.whyCN: 不经同意的权力常以智慧自辩；这个短语记录的正是这种辩解。

senses.title: In the workplace
senses.definition: a manager who decides without consulting the team
senses.definitionCN: 不经团队商议便自行决断的管理者
senses.example: Staff turnover revealed the new director was an autocrat.
senses.exampleCN: 员工流失率暴露出新主管是个独断专行者。
senses.why: Management language borrowed the political type to grade its bosses.
senses.whyCN: 管理学借来这个政治形象为自己的上司分等。

senses.title: In history writing
senses.definition: a historical figure characterized as concentrating power personally
senses.definitionCN: 被描述为个人集权的历史人物
senses.example: Historians debate whether the first emperor was an autocrat or a reformer.
senses.exampleCN: 史家争论开国皇帝究竟是独裁者还是改革者。
senses.why: History sorts rulers by how much they shared, and autocrat marks the bottom of the scale.
senses.whyCN: 史学按「分权多少」为君主排序，autocrat 标在这条标尺的底端。

senses.title: In family life
senses.definition: a family member who dominates household decisions
senses.definitionCN: 支配家庭决策的家庭成员
senses.example: Aunt Agatha was the acknowledged autocrat of the household.
senses.exampleCN: 阿加莎姨妈是公认的一家之主（独断者）。
senses.why: The word's bite makes it a favorite of novelists sketching tyrannical aunts and fathers.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的讥刺劲儿使它成了小说家刻画暴君式姑妈与父亲的偏爱。

senses.title: Autocrat versus related rulers
senses.titleCN: autocrat 与近义统治者之辨
senses.definition: distinguished from tyrant, despot, and dictator by its systemic, Greek-derived tone
senses.definitionCN: 与 tyrant、despot、dictator 相区别：语气更具政体性与希腊色彩
senses.example: A dictator seizes power; an autocrat inherits or claims it as a system.
senses.exampleCN: dictator 靠夺取上台；autocrat 则以体制继承或自封集权。
senses.why: Each word for absolute rule carries its own biography: seizure, household, or system.
senses.whyCN: 每个「绝对统治者」的称呼都自带出身：或夺取、或家宅、或体制。

intro.en: Autocrat comes from Greek autokrates, ruling by oneself, from autos, self, plus kratos, power; Russian tsars popularized the title in the eighteenth century, and English adopted both the title and the mocking domestic use.
intro.cn: autocrat 出自希腊语 autokrates「独自统治」，由 autos「自身」加 kratos「权力」构成；18 世纪俄国沙皇的帝号使其广为人知，英语随之收入该称号及其戏谑的家用义。

items.en: The root *kreH- meant strength or power, giving Greek kratos and such English words as democracy.
items.cn: 词根 *kreH- 意为「力量、权势」，衍生出希腊语 kratos，以及英语 democracy 等词。

items.en: autos meant self and kratos meant power; autokrates meant ruling alone, autokrator the ruler who does.
items.cn: 希腊语 autos 意为「自身」，kratos 意为「权力」；autokrates 意为独自统治，autokrator 即如此行事之人。

items.en: autokrator was a Greek title for commanders and emperors with full authority.
items.cn: autokrator 是授予全权统帅与皇帝的希腊称号。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the tsars' title, translated as autocrat, made the word famous across Europe.
items.cn: 18 世纪，沙皇的头衔被译作 autocrat，使这个词风行欧洲。

items.en: English recorded autocrat in the 1760s, at first referring to the tsar and other absolute monarchs.
items.cn: 英语在 18 世纪 60 年代记录下 autocrat，最初指沙皇等绝对君主。

items.en: Nineteenth-century essayists extended it to any bossy person, from railway directors to aunts.
items.cn: 19 世纪随笔作家将其扩展到一切专横之人，从铁路公司董事到姑妈。

note.en: Group one collects the kratos family and auto- look-alikes; group two collects neighboring words for absolute rulers.
note.cn: 第一组收 kratos 词族及 auto- 形近词；第二组收相邻的绝对统治者称呼。

entries.definition: the system an autocrat runs; government by one absolute ruler.
entries.definitionCN: autocrat 所运行的体制；一人绝对统治。

entries.definition: a noble, from aristos, best, plus kratos; same ending, different claim to power.
entries.definitionCN: 贵族，出自 aristos「最优秀者」+ kratos；共享词尾而掌权依据不同。

entries.definition: an official in a bureau; the paper-shuffling cousin of the -crat family.
entries.definitionCN: 官僚；-crat 家族中管文牍的近亲。

entries.definition: self-law, from nomos; shares auto- but names freedom, not domination.
entries.definitionCN: 自治，出自 nomos「法」；共享 auto- 而指自由而非支配。

entries.definition: a self-moving machine, from automatos; shares auto- only.
entries.definitionCN: 自动机械，出自 automatos；仅共享 auto-。

entries.definition: an absolute ruler, originally a Roman emergency magistrate.
entries.definitionCN: 独裁者；原指罗马临时专政官。

entries.definition: a ruler with absolute power, often cruel; Greek household master.
entries.definitionCN: 暴君；源自希腊语家主一词。

entries.definition: a cruel and oppressive ruler, originally a Greek usurper.
a single hereditary ruler, constitutional or absolute.
entries.definitionCN: 君主；可为立宪，可为专制。

entries.definition: demanding obedience; the adjective flavor of autocratic rule.
entries.definitionCN: 威权主义的；要求绝对服从。

normalIntro.en: autocrat is auto plus crat: self plus power, the one-person government.
normalIntro.cn: autocrat = auto + crat：自身 + 权力——一个人的政府。

normal.en: auto (self) + kratos (power): power that answers to itself alone.
normal.cn: auto（自身）+ kratos（权力）：只对自身负责的权力。

normal.en: The -crat family: autocrat, aristocrat, bureaucrat, democrat.
The Russian tsar's official title made autocrat a household word.
normal.cn: 俄国沙皇的正式帝号使 autocrat 成了家喻户晓的词。

normal.en: autocracy is the system; the autocrat is the person.
normal.cn: autocracy 是体制，autocrat 是其人。

normal.en: Modern use: any boss who decides everything is a kitchen-table autocrat.
normal.cn: 现代用法：凡独断一切者，皆是餐桌上的 autocrat。

abstract.en: Picture a single chair at the head of a very long table, and everyone else standing.
abstract.cn: 想象长桌尽头只有一把椅子，其余人全部站立。

abstract.en: The word walks like a ruler: no one voted for it.
abstract.cn: 这个词走起路来像君王：没人投过它的票。

abstract.en: Autocrat is the uncle who decides the weather.
abstract.cn: autocrat 是那位连天气都要拍板的舅舅。

examples.en: The new CEO was an autocrat who tolerated no debate.
examples.cn: 新任总裁是个不容辩论的独断者。

examples.en: For centuries the tsar was Europe's most famous autocrat.
examples.cn: 数百年来，沙皇一直是欧洲最著名的独裁君主。

examples.en: She ruled the committee like a benevolent autocrat.
examples.cn: 她以开明专制者的姿态执掌委员会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特克拉」——奥特之父奥克大拉，家里大事小事全由他一人拍板

root: 出自希腊语 autokrates「独自统治的」（autos「自身」+ kratos「权力」），其名词 autokrator 为全权统帅称号；经 18 世纪沙皇帝号（autocrat of all the Russias）流行，18 世纪 60 年代进入英语；与 aristocrat、bureaucrat 共享 -crat 词尾，词源确凿。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move one word from throne to kitchen: the absolute monarch, the bossy boss, the dominating aunt, and the fine differences among tyrants, despots, and dictators.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义词让一个词从王座走进厨房：绝对君主、专断上司、支配欲极强的姑妈，以及 tyrant、despot、dictator 之间的细微差别。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand holding every decision, everyone else waiting.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手攥着所有决定，其余人只能等待。

branches.en: THE THRONE SIDE: tsars and emperors as system incarnate.
branches.cn: 王座一面：作为体制化身的沙皇与皇帝。

branches.en: THE DOMESTIC SIDE: bosses, directors, and aunts who rule alone.
branches.cn: 家常一面：独断的上司、主管与姑妈。

branches.en: THE EXCUSE SIDE: the benevolent autocrat's claim to wisdom.
branches.cn: 自辩一面：开明专制者自诩的智慧。

branches.en: THE HISTORY SIDE: rulers graded by the power they shared.
branches.cn: 史学一面：以分权多少为尺度的君主。

branches.en: THE FAMILY SIDE: autocrat beside tyrant, despot, dictator.
branches.cn: 词族一面：与 tyrant、despot、dictator 并列的 autocrat。

intro.en: autocrat is autos plus krates: the self-powered ruler; the -crat suffix names whoever holds a kind of power.
intro.cn: autocrat 由 autos 加 krates 构成：自我赋能的统治者；-crat 词尾为各类掌权者命名。

latinIntro.en: Greek kratos, power, built a wide family in English: autocrat, aristocrat, bureaucrat, democrat, technocrat.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 kratos「权力」在英语中构建了庞大家族：autocrat、aristocrat、bureaucrat、democrat、technocrat。

items.meaning: one who holds a kind of power
rule by a kind of power
a noble, one of the best-born rulers
one who supports rule by the people
